subject: Novel Method
source_sentence: We present a novel method that (1) exploits a pre-trained neural language model to obtain contextualised representations for every occurrence of a word of interest, (2) clusters these representations into usage types , and (3) measures change along time.
title: Analysing Lexical Semantic Change with Contextualised Word Representations

subject: BERT Language Model
source_sentence: we use the BERT language model to compute usage representations for each occurrence of these words.
title: Analysing Lexical Semantic Change with Contextualised Word Representations
section: 3 Method: A Usage-based Approach to Lexical Semantic Change

subject: BERT Language Model
source_sentence: We produce usage representations using the BERT language model , a multi- layer bidirectional Transformer encoder trained on masked token prediction and next sentence prediction, on the BooksCorpus (800M words ) and on English text passages extracted from Wikipedia (2,500M words ).
title: Analysing Lexical Semantic Change with Contextualised Word Representations
